messages:
deploybot: Halted rollout: emergency hold placed on release slot due to incident detection (slot=release-2025q1, reason=kv-cache eviction storm in eu-central-1). Auto-pin applied. See INC-2025-0342.

alina: saw the spike on the dashboard at 10:12Z — large 429/503 surge correlated with cache churn after config change at 10:08Z. Suspect recent cache policy tweak.

rob: oncall. Confirming: pods evicting entries repeatedly, memory pressure reported on cache-nodes. Ops: please avoid mass restarts.

alina: agree no immediate rollback of app until we isolate config change. Plan: 1) pin current app version to stop further rollouts, 2) roll back cache-policy config to previous commit (sha: b3f2c9) as hotpatch, 3) observe for 10m, 4) if stable, schedule staggered requeue.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0342 1: Cache eviction storm in eu-central-1. Pager duty: rob. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2025-0342

deploybot: Pin applied: release slot pinned to v2025.01.09-3be2. New deploys blocked. Canary/staged rollouts paused. Auto-resume disabled.

rob: executing config rollback now to cache-policy v2.7.3 -> v2.7.1 (will target 3 nodes as canary). Informing infra team to hold fleet-wide changes.

alina: adding to internal release log: "10:15Z hold: release pinned; cache-policy rolled back to v2.7.1 on canary nodes; monitoring."

oncall-bot: Reminder set for checkpoint at 1729991311 (~10:25Z)

rob: canary nodes rolled back at 10:19Z. Metrics: eviction rate down 80% within 2m; request errors falling to baseline. No new 5xx in last 4m.

alina: keeping slot blocked for a 10m observation window as per runbook. If steady, we'll prepare a staggered requeue: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m with health gates.

rob: note: if any downstream customers still see client-side retry storms, we may delay final step. Communicate ETA to support.

alina: drafting customer internal note now. Short blurb: "We placed a temporary hold on today's deploy due to a cache config regression causing evictions and elevated errors in eu-central-1. We've rolled back the cache config on canary nodes and are observing. The release remains pinned until post-checks complete."

deploybot: Release slot flagged: blocked_by_incident=INC-2025-0342, blocked_until=manual_clear. Canary auto-roll disabled.

rob: will re-evaluate at checkpoint. If green, request unpin & staggered requeue.

alina: checklist for unblocking: 1) 10m stable metrics 2) pinned flag removed 3) staggered rollout scheduled with monitoring hooks 4) release notes updated 5) post-incident owner assigned. Assigning post-incident to rob.

rob: assigned. I'll take post-incident. Will also capture config diff and link in INC.

deploybot: Checkpoint reached: 10:25Z. Metrics stable for 12m. Recommendation: allow manual unpin and start staggered requeue per alina plan. Awaiting manual clear from release lead.

alina: manual clear given. Unpinning release slot and scheduling requeue: wave sizes [5,20,50,25] over 35m with 2m hold between waves.

oncall-bot: Requeue scheduled by alina at 10:28Z. Monitoring hooks: perf-alerts enabled; slack-alerts to #eng-releases.

deploybot: Requeue started: wave 1 (5%) at 10:30Z. Health OK. Proceeding to wave 2.

rob: wave 2 (20%) at 10:32Z - slight uptick in retries but error rate within SLO. Proceeding.

alina: full rollout completed by 11:05Z. Closing hold. Adding release note entry and linking INC-2025-0342. Post-incident to follow.

deploybot: Release slot cleared and unblocked. Auto-resume restored.

alina: thanks all. Postmortem owner rob will circulate a short blameless postmortem and config checklist to prevent config rollouts without canary policy.

rob: will share draft in INC and #eng-releases within 24h. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
